name: RA_ACCOUNT_DEFAULT_SEGMENTS_
description: The RA_ACCOUNT_DEFAULT_SEGMENTS table stores AutoAccounting setup information. Each row in this table represents an Accounting Flexfield segment and information about how AutoAccounting derives the value of that segment. . The primary key for this table is GL_DEFAULT_SEGMENT_ID.
